articles.title: A 16-Year-Old Guitar Shredder From Thailand Just Won America's Got Talent
articles.summary: Nene Royal is a 16-year-old guitar player from Thailand. She rocked America's Got Talent with a heavy version of the song "Zombie" and won the whole show. Her audition got 21 million views!

articles.title: A Teen Swimmer From Ohio Just Made a Huge Splash — Committing to Texas A&M
articles.summary: Owen Gee, a high school swimmer from Ohio, has committed to swim at Texas A&M University. He's really fast in butterfly and freestyle. He'll join the team in 2028.

articles.title: Britain's Tennis Team Fights Hard but Falls to Czech Republic in Billie Jean King Cup
articles.summary: Great Britain lost to the Czech Republic in the Billie Jean King Cup quarter-finals. Sonay Kartal played a three-hour match after six months out with a back injury. Captain Anne Keothavong said she "cannot fault" her team.
